section: 8. Depths of the Netherworld: Exploration and Encounters
description: Delving deep into the Netherworld, encountering various obstacles and guardians, exploring the path to Hakugyokurou, and engaging in battles with various beings of the underworld.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “I still have a long way to go to surpass such a performance by myself...”

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: “One against four, strictly speaking, we've already lost.”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “Huh? Did... did we succeed?”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er, steaming and sweating, stops drumming.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “Miss Lunasa's performance was also very good, but I feel like just you alone might be a bit too thin.”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “Well played.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “Music isn't about numbers. A win is a win.”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “The most classic for violin should be a trio, or a string quartet.”

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “For me, spring is like your other sisters. Without it, I can't sing songs like this.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “That's true~”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “Speaking of which... who commissioned Miss Lunasa to be here?”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “That place is a forbidden zone for the living.”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “The Princess of... the Netherworld?”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “She is an ancient spirit.”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “No matter what, we must bring spring back.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Lunasa sighs.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “Even if I die, I'll haunt her!”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “Thank you for your kindness, but we really must do this. After resolving the incident, let's hold a concert together.” #Walks to Lunasa's side.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “If I die, I'll just grow back from the tree. Oh, but if it's always winter, I guess I can't bear fruit.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “The master of Hakugyokurou is that Princess, and also my client.”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “We will win.” #Looks firmly at Lunasa.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “Naturally, but then it'll be me and my little sisters coming together.”

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “Let's play together again when you return.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She smiles.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “Don't worry, I promised that guy I wouldn't die. None of us will die. We're still waiting to go back for dinner tonight.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “I hope you return safely. Let's play together then.”

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: “And also...” #More than the threat of death, the endless stream of obstacles is what irritates Ge Qing.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “See you later.” #Enters the Myoujin Gate.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “Yeah, see you later.”

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “Goodbye.” #Waves goodbye and walks towards the Myoujin Gate.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Stepping into the Myojin Gate

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I'll come back to find Miss Lunasa, please be sure to teach me an instrument then" #Waving hand while stepping into the Myojin Gate

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er, Lina, and the others walked into the Myojin Gate

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ugh..." #Supporting Suncan who emerged from the shadows

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp+3

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Infinite Tenjoin Long'er]'s 'Existence Record'... updated: [MP]: 10+3=13

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Ugh..." #Lying motionless on the ground

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: On both sides, countless suspended, motionless red spider lilies float in the void, their petals frozen in the moment of falling. The air is filled with the mixed scent of sandalwood and old paper. The Spring Energy light points previously inhaled now converge into streams, silently flowing upward against the current. The top of the staircase is shrouded in bluish mist, obscuring the path ahead.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .st mp+1

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Existence Record'... updated: [MP]: 10+1=11

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This... this staircase?" #Adapting to the discomfort and looking up at the endless white staircase

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Outside the Netherworld, Lunasa sighed.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Let's go."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "If you go through the gate behind, that's the staircase leading up to Hakugyokurou."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Carrying Lina on back, climbing up the staircase

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "It strips the living of their sense of time."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Immediately walking onto the staircase

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Then, inside the gate, you all are still standing at the foot of the staircase.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Grr... th... thank you."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As Ge Qing walked up the staircase, the mist ahead cleared a little.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Biting own hand hard to regain composure, then walking onto the staircase

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Stepping on the staircase, all that can be seen is the next step.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Climbing step by step "By the way, do you know the origin of the Hakugyokurou典故?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I'm not really sure... Actually, this is the first time I've heard this name."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er climbs step by step. The higher they go, the more apprehensive they feel. This staircase seems endless; you can't even sense how long you've been climbing.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The典故 comes from Li He's writing. When Changji was dying..." #Stopping to catch breath

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er stops to rest briefly. Behind is shrouded in mist, obscuring the path taken; above is also shrouded in mist, obscuring the path ahead.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Something's wrong... how long have we been walking?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: This path has no future or past.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "A person dressed in red came and told him that the Jade Emperor had built a Hakugyokurou, asking him to go there to write articles. Although he died, this heavenly duty wouldn't make him suffer."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Even now it's hard to distinguish, hard to perceive.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "So knowledgeable."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I see... So there's actually such a saying for this?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So many scholars strive with the goal that their writings can catch her eye and allow them to enter Hakugyokurou after death."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Ge Qing summons his mind's eye, beginning to scan the surroundings like radar.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Activate ability #Connection of Life and Death! Turn myself into a living dead!

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+5d4=1+{1+3+2+4+3}(13)=14 Challenge: 10 Critical Failure Success Level: 1-1(Critical Failure)=0

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .sh5d4

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp-1

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjōin Long'er]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [MP]: 13-1=12

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let me see the world through the eyes of the dead."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .stmp-1

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [MP]: 11-1=10

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In the mind's eye, the perceived surroundings are still enveloped in a kind of chaos.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "This fog is really strange..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "These stairs... what could they be made of? Could it be white jade?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Grabs Ge Qing, "Don't walk out anymore, I'm afraid I won't be able to find you if you go into the fog."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Then if we dig a little piece off, can we buy lots of delicious food?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjōin Long'er]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+Psychic Ability(3)d4+2d4=12+{3+1+3}(7)+{4+2}(6)=25 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 3

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .shPsychic Abilityd4+2d4

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm... I want to taste it..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp-1

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjōin Long'er]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [MP]: 12-1=11

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As Long'er's vitality gradually fades,

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Long... Long'er? What's wrong with you?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Looking forward, Long'er realizes they never actually stepped onto the stairs, but have been marching in place on the original clearing all along.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Thank you for worrying about me. It's fine, this is my ability." #Has everyone hold hands.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The steps of Hakugyokurou are at their side.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I'll lead the way." #Walks at the front, heading upwards.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yes!" #Grips the others' hands tightly.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Even stepping onto the real staircase, this climb feels especially long.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "It seems this is a form of protection for the living."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: After what feels like an endless climb, at the top of the stairs, you see a massive gate looming in the distance. It's an archway constructed from ancient wood and pale stone, slightly ajar, with pale cherry blossom petals constantly drifting from the crack. Countless Spring Energy points converge here into a dazzling vortex, flowing into that gap like rivers to the sea. The world beyond the gate is obscured by surging cherry blossom hues, and from within, you can only hear a faint, ethereal fragrance that seems capable of awakening slumbering spirits.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "You might be right."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: This should be the entrance.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Protection for the living... It seems this is a world not meant for us."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Though I can't see it clearly yet, I feel like spring is nearby."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So beautiful, gatekeeper, don't you agree?" #Looking around, Long'er remembers Rumia said there would be a gatekeeper.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: No response. The gatekeeper is nowhere to be seen.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The gatekeeper... clocked out?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Could it be that the shrine maiden has already been here?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "No trick revealed, no one here?" #Goes to push the door.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The moment Long'er approaches the door, an anomaly occurs. A silver arc of sword energy, like a crescent moon, cleaves through the overflowing stream of Spring Energy, suddenly appearing from behind the door, missing Long'er's body by a hair's breadth. Death. That's the thought that flashes through Long'er's mind in that instant. But because of it, he has time to react to this strike.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #The flow of time around Long'er seems to slow for a moment. Sweating coldly, he extends his left hand wearing the gauntlet and forcefully throws a left hook at the side of the sword energy. The sturdy glove strikes directly at a weak point of the energy, forcefully shattering it.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjōin Ryūji]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+Psychic Ability(3)d4+3d4=17+{1+2+1}(4)+{2+4+3}(9)=30 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 4

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .sh Psychic Ability d4+3d4

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The silvery-white sword energy is instantly shattered by you. Consequently, you are forced back a few steps.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp-1

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjōin Ryūji]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [MP]: 11-1=10

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Taking advantage of the opening you created, a half-phantom girl materializes from the swirling cherry blossom blizzard, her long and short tachi crossed before her into a cross of cold light. She lightly taps her toes on the threshold, shaking petals from her blades. Behind her, countless severed Spring Energy points are dissipating with mournful cries. "Beyond this gate," she lowers the tip of Hakurouken slightly, "is the eternal slumber of the living." "This is as far as you go, outsiders."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Wh-what's going on?" #Trembling but moving succinctly, drawing the saw cleaver from her back, Sūn Cān also manifests beside Xue Yu.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Lifts her head, revealing a beautiful face beneath pure white hair.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Sh-she appeared!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: This is a girl of about 16 or 17 years old. The half-human, half-phantom gardener, Konpaku Youmu. [CQ:image,file=2B097D8558A42134CDC920331A5A73B8.jpg,subType=0,url=https://multimedia.nt.qq.com.cn/download?appid=1407&fileid=EhTL1CUM9wiUCYZMDiOuXEbC7taagBjWyQEg_woowY-1prXCkAMyBHByb2RQgL2jAVoQwDVgNnNa5tIbgfmWtVvaTHoCyFOCAQJneg&spec=0&rkey=CAMSMBIuZ6-jGLxsrWc1b5c8ph0nGqyUcEb_d-FDXxtIXgTnGlK20qJzhAa_rYaV4HEPbg,file_size=25814]

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Aren't you not dead either?" #Sarcastic remark.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "But... you don't look like one of the deceased."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Konpaku Youmu. Please leave this place, outsiders." As she speaks, the spirit behind her flies out.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Deactivates her ability, reverting from a zombie back to a human.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We've come all this way... I'm not leaving until you give back our spring."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Seems to be demonstrating her half-human, half-phantom nature.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It feels great to be able to breathe."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Then... if I die, can I pass through?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She responds with silence.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Don't make it hard for her. Let's break through by force."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Without that princess's permission, no one can pass."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mr. Tenjouin, can your ability be used on others?" #whispers

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I'm sorry. Even though she's willful, I can't let you disturb her."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I don't like using this ability on others."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I'm not afraid of you... probably."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Alright... and it doesn't seem like this is working anyway."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Yawn—, no point in more talk, let's fight."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Hearing the observer's words, the girl first closes her eyes.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Xueyu grips her saw cleaver tightly. In contrast to the nervous Xueyu, the Suncan beside her shows a ravenous, drooling expression towards the girl before them.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Let me make this clear first, there's almost nothing this Louguan Sword cannot cut—"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Can you cut Spring Energy?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl raises her sword.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Activate ability, you keep cutting Spring Energy endlessly, Youmu!

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl gently brushes past the falling petals, her right hand resting on the sword at her waist.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er takes out a ticking pocket watch from his chest and looks at Youmu, who just cut the Spring Energy. He uses his finger to turn the hands on the watch's dial. The surrounding time gradually slows, and Youmu's face, showing a humiliated and angry expression from being tricked, can faintly be seen. As he gradually turns the watch's second hand, Youmu begins to rewind like a tape, reverting to her previous action of slashing the Spring Energy, the sword's blade moving back along its upward trajectory.
